ModMetaData.name: Construction Performance Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description:
Helps construction-heavy colonies run more smoothly by reducing repeated construction work while preserving normal RimWorld behavior.
The branch is compiled against RimWorld 1.0. This build supports single-player. Multiplayer support begins with the separate RimWorld 1.5 build.
Requires Harmony. No settings or save data. Do not enable this with Construction Queue Optimizer because that legacy package contains the same patches.
